arxiv-1610-04501.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Tord Riemann. The proposed e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} -collider FCC-ee aims at an unprecedented accuracy for e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} collisions into fermion pairs at the Z Z peak, based on about 10 13 10^{13} events.

arxiv-2107-13770.title: Controlled preparation of phases in two-dimensional time crystals
arxiv-2107-13770.creator: Arkadiusz Kuroś, Rick Mukherjee, Florian Mintert, Krzysztof Sacha
arxiv-2107-13770.description: Abstract The study of phases is useful for understanding novel states of matter. One such state of matter are time crystals which constitute periodically driven interacting many-body systems that spontaneously break time translation symmetry. Time crystals with arbitrary periods (and dimensions) can be realized using the model of Bose-Einstein condensates bouncing on periodically-driven mirror(s).

arxiv-2208-08172.title: The nonlinear Benjamin-Feir instability – Hamiltonian dynamics, primitive breathers, and steady solutions
arxiv-2208-08172.creator: David Andrade & Raphael Stuhlmeier
arxiv-2208-08172.description: Abstract We develop a general framework to describe the cubically nonlinear interaction of a unidirectional degenerate quartet of deep-water gravity waves. Starting from the discretised Zakharov equation, and thus without restriction on spectral bandwidth, we derive a planar Hamiltonian system in terms of the dynamic phase and a modal amplitude.

arxiv-2211-01397.title: The fate of discrete torsion on resolved heterotic
arxiv-2211-01397.creator: ℤ
arxiv-2211-01397.description: Abstract LTH-1318 Abstract This paper aims to shed light on what becomes of discrete torsion within heterotic orbifolds when they are resolved to smooth geometries. Gauged Linear Sigma Models (GLSMs) possessing (0,2) worldsheet supersymmetry are employed as interpolations between them.

arxiv-2302-07750.title: Approximate SU(4) spin models on triangular and honeycomb lattices in twisted AB-Stacked WSe 2 homobilayer
arxiv-2302-07750.creator: Shuchen Zhang, Boran Zhou, Ya-Hui Zhang
arxiv-2302-07750.description: Abstract In this paper, we derive lattice models for the narrow moiré bands of the AB-stacked twisted WSe 2 homobilayer through continuum model and Wannier orbital construction. Previous work has shown that an approximate SU(4) Hubbard model may be realized by combining spin and layer because inter-layer tunneling is suppressed due to spin S z S_{z} conservation.

arxiv-2410-17348.title: User Experience Evaluation of AR Assisted Industrial Maintenance and Support Applications
arxiv-2410-17348.creator: Akos Nagy, Yannis Spyridis, Gregory J Mills, Vasileios Argyriou
arxiv-2410-17348.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Akos Nagy, Yannis Spyridis, Gregory J Mills, Vasileios Argyriou. The paper introduces an innovative approach to industrial maintenance leveraging augmented reality (AR) technology, focusing on enhancing the user experience and efficiency. The shift from traditional to proactive maintenance strategies underscores the significance of maintenance in industrial systems. The proposed solution integrates AR interfaces, particularly through Head-Mounted Display (HMD) devices, to provide expert personnel-aided decision support for maintenance technicians, with the association of Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions.

arxiv-2411-01320.title: Cayley Hamilton algebras and a paper by Skip Garibaldi
arxiv-2411-01320.creator: Claudio Procesi
arxiv-2411-01320.description: Abstract . In this paper we discuss the minimal Cayley Hamilton norm for a finite dimensional algebra over a field F F based on a paper by Skip Garibaldi [ 2 ] . 1. Introduction Since this paper is on Cayley–Hamilton algebras let me recall their formal definition Definition 1.1 .

arxiv-2503-16078.title: Magnetic skyrmions embedded in a vortex
arxiv-2503-16078.creator: Haobing Zhang, Xintao Fan, Weiwei Wang
arxiv-2503-16078.description: Abstract Magnetic vortices and skyrmions represent two fundamental classes of topological spin textures in ferromagnetic systems, distinguished by their unique stabilization mechanisms and degrees of freedom. Vortices, characterized by circular in-plane magnetization (chirality) and out-of-plane core polarization, naturally arise in confined geometries due to the interplay between exchange and dipolar interactions.

arxiv-2504-06506.title: Some Remarks on the Product Formula for Defect Numbers of Closed Operators
arxiv-2504-06506.creator: Christoph Fischbacher, Fritz Gesztesy, Lance L. Littlejohn
arxiv-2504-06506.description: Abstract . This largely pedagogical note recalls some facts on defect numbers of products of closed operators employing results from the theory of semi-Fredholm operators and then applies these facts to positive integer powers of symmetric operators and subsequently to certain minimal Sturm–Liouville and minimal higher even-order ordinary differential operators.

arxiv-2506-16314.title: Signatures to help interpretability of anomalies
arxiv-2506-16314.creator: Emmanuel Gangler \orcidID 0000-0001-6728-1423, Emille E. O. Ishida \orcidID 0000-0002-0406-076X, Matwey V. Kornilov \orcidID 0000-0002-5193-9806, Vladimir Korolev \orcidID 0009-0008-7691-6142, Anastasia Lavrukhina \orcidID 0009-0002-0835-7998, Konstantin Malanchev \orcidID 0000-0001-7179-7406, Maria
arxiv-2506-16314.description: Abstract Machine learning is often viewed as a black box when it comes to understanding its output, be it a decision or a score. Automatic anomaly detection is no exception to this rule, and quite often the astronomer is left to independently analyze the data in order to understand why a given event is tagged as an anomaly.

arxiv-2510-07959.title: DISCO: Diversifying Sample Condensation for Efficient Model Evaluation
arxiv-2510-07959.creator: Alexander Rubinstein, Benjamin Raible, Martin Gubri, Seong Joon Oh, [0.15cm] Tübingen AI Center, University of Tübingen
arxiv-2510-07959.description: Abstract Evaluating modern machine learning models has become prohibitively expensive. Benchmarks such as LMMs-Eval and HELM demand thousands of GPU hours per model. Costly evaluation reduces inclusivity, slows the cycle of innovation, and worsens environmental impact. The typical approach follows two steps. First, select an anchor subset of data.

arxiv-2511-17515.title: Embedding Generative AI into Systems Analysis and Design Curriculum: Framework, Case Study, and Cross-Campus Empirical Evidence
arxiv-2511-17515.creator: Mahmoud Elkhodr, Ergun Gide
arxiv-2511-17515.description: Abstract Systems analysis students increasingly use Generative AI, yet current pedagogy lacks systematic approaches for teaching responsible AI orchestration that fosters critical thinking whilst meeting educational outcomes. Students risk accepting AI suggestions blindly or uncritically without assessing alignment with user needs or contextual appropriateness.

arxiv-2512-10676.title: On Neutral Edge Sets in Anti-Ramsey Numbers
arxiv-2512-10676.creator: Ali Ghalavand, Qing Jie, Zemin Jin, Xueliang Li, Linshu Pan
arxiv-2512-10676.description: Abstract The anti-Ramsey number of a graph G G , introduced by Erdős et al. in 1975, is the maximum number of colors in an edge-coloring of the complete graph K n K_{n} that avoids a rainbow copy of G G .

pmc-10643115.title: Gliadin and glutenin genomes and their effects on the technological aspect of wheat-based products
pmc-10643115.creator: Kiana Pourmohammadi, Elahe Abedi, Seyed Mohammad Bagher Hashemi
pmc-10643115.description: Wheat is the most important crops worldwide, providing about one-fifth of the daily protein and calories for human consumption. The quality of cereal-based products is principally governed by the genetic basis of gluten (glutenin and gliadin proteins), which exists in a wide range of variable alleles and is controlled by clusters of genes.

pmc-10805577.title: The West Riding Lunatic Asylum Medical Reports: the precursor of Brain?
pmc-10805577.creator: Andrew J Larner
pmc-10805577.description: First published in 1878, Brain: A Journal of Neurology is generally considered to be the world’s first neuroscientific journal. However, this claim might be challenged since the West Riding Lunatic Asylum Medical Reports, another journal with significant neuroscientific content, was published between 1871 and 1876.

pmc-11692484.title: INTERGENERATIONAL COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT: LESSONS LEARNED FROM THE SENIOR TO SENIOR DINNER DANCE PROGRAM
pmc-11692484.creator: Youjung Lee, Jacqueline McGinley
pmc-11692484.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Intergenerational engagement is a universal human development process that helps older adults’ successful aging (Krzeczkowska et al., 2021) and children’s optimal development (McAlister et al., 2019). As part of an age-friendly initiative in a small city in New York State, an intergenerational engagement program (Senior to Senior Dinner Dance) involved a multi-year partnership between community agencies, including a local Office for Aging, university, high school, senior center, and church.

pmc-11714081.title: Differential association of moderate alcohol use with neurodegeneration, cerebrovascular disease, and cognition by racial, ethnic and sex/gender groups in middle age
pmc-11714081.creator: Diana S Guzmán, Miguel Arce Rentería, Justina F Avila, Indira C Turney, Aubrey S Johnson, Anna C Smith, Amarachukwu Okafor, Hannah M Houlihan, Lauren B Heuer, Mohamad J Alshikho, Clarissa Morales, Jessica Mazen, Yian Gu, Jennifer J Manly, Adam M Brickman, Patrick J Lao
pmc-11714081.description: BackgroundModerate alcohol use may be associated with brain and cognitive benefits compared to heavy alcohol use. However, results have varied. We hypothesized that the relationship between alcohol use and cognition is mediated by neurodegenerative and cerebrovascular measures in a diverse middle‐aged sample of non‐alcohol dependent community‐dwelling adults in Northern Manhattan.

pmc-12339164.title: Bidirectional Crosstalk between the Heart and Brain in Alzheimer's Disease
pmc-12339164.creator: Zhitian Wang, Lv Zhou, Na Zhao, Zhijun Zhang, Junjian Zhang, Qing-Guo Ren
pmc-12339164.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder condition linked to various systemic comorbidities. Numerous studies have shown bidirectional crosstalk between the heart and the brain, but the specifics of how these interactions occur in AD are poorly understood. This narrative review summarizes the clinical evidence for a firm link between AD and cardiovascular health and discusses the bidirectional roles of AD and the cardiovascular system.

pmc-12679233.title: Cancer cell-dependent increase in senescence-like populations following exosome treatment from bone marrow and induced pluripotent stem cell-derived mesenchymal stem cells
pmc-12679233.creator: Nidaa A Ababneh, Sura Nashwan, Razan AlDiqs, Mohammad A Ismail, Ahmed A Abdulelah, Anas H A Abu-Humaidan, Lina AlQirem, Khairallah Al-Abdallat, Talal Al-Qaisi, Tareq Saleh, Abdalla Awidi
pmc-12679233.description: BACKGROUNDMesenchymal stem cell (MSC) extracellular vesicles, particularly exosomes (Exos), are gaining recognition as promising therapeutic tools for cancer due to their capacity to modulate tumor cell biology. Induced pluripotent stem cell-derived MSCs (iMSCs) revealed therapeutic characteristics compared with conventional MSCs due to their proliferative capacity and enhanced differentiation potential.

pmc-13065950.title: Soluble epoxide hydrolase in the liver orchestrates abdominal aortic aneurysm formation in mice
pmc-13065950.creator: David S Kim, Tetsuo Horimatsu, Mourad Ogbi, Brandee Goo, Hong Shi, Praneet Veerapaneni, Ronnie Chouhaita, Nicole Cyriac, Mary Moses, Rosaria Prasad, Stephen Cave, Tyler W Benson, Ragheb Harb, Ghaith Aboud, Hunter G Sellers, Mitchell Shivers, Stephen Haigh, David J Fulton, Gábor Csányi, Yuqing Huo, X
pmc-13065950.description: The liver plays an important role in cardiovascular disease by amplifying systemic inflammation, while the underlying mechanisms remain to be defined. Soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) is a pro-inflammatory enzyme, and pharmacological inhibition of sEH was shown to protect against various inflammatory diseases.

pmc-13241312.title: Haploidentical transplantation with post-transplant cyclophosphamide is not inferior to 9/10-MUD transplantation with ATG in patients with myeloid malignancies
pmc-13241312.creator: Andrea Gantner, Svenja Labuhn, Daniel Fürst, Sophie Mannes, Sarah Flossdorf, Francis Ayuketang Ayuk, Thomas Schroeder, Matthias Stelljes, Robert Zeiser, Peter Dreger, Matthias Eder, Igor Wolfgang Blau, Johannes Schetelig, Arne Brecht, Andreas Burchert, Matthias Edinger, Verena Wais, Hubert Schrezenm
pmc-13241312.description: The selection of the best available donor is crucial for patients’ outcome after allogeneic stem cell transplantation (allo-SCT). In the absence of fully Human leucocyte antigen (HLA) -matched donors, mismatched unrelated donor (9/10-MUD) or haploidentical donor (haplo) can be considered. No consensus has been reached on the best alternative and large real-world data are warranted to support decisional processes.

pmc-13377057.title: Robust intensification of projected regional precipitation extremes over Africa
pmc-13377057.creator: Akintomide A. Akinsanola, Thierry N. Taguela, Vishal Bobde
pmc-13377057.description: Extreme rainfall is increasing under climate warming, but its future patterns across Africa remain highly uncertain. Using Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) simulations, we assess projected changes in annual maximum one-day precipitation (Rx1day) and rare precipitation extremes across African subregions under both SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 scenarios.

pmc-13435537.title: An Unusual Case of Renal-Limited Giant Cell Arteritis
pmc-13435537.creator: Sarah Crowder, Prajwol Pant, Mario Madruga, Steve Carlan
pmc-13435537.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). It is widely accepted that giant cell arteritis (GCA) is a disease of the carotid branches. There are very few cases describing disseminated disease or visceral involvement. Isolated renal GCA presenting with renal failure is even more unusual.A 76-year-old male with no known medical history presented to the emergency department with three weeks of weakness, swelling, oliguria, and shortness of breath. He was started on hemodialysis for renal failure.
